relations.subject: Hermann Wilhelm Ebel
relations.evidence: At the age of sixteen he became a student at the University of Berlin, applying himself especially to philology, and attending the lectures of August Böckh.

relations.subject: Hermann Wilhelm Ebel
relations.evidence: attending the lectures of August Böckh.

relations.subject: Hermann Wilhelm Ebel
relations.evidence: In the spring of 1838 he passed to the University of Halle, and there began to apply himself to comparative philology under August Pott.

relations.subject: Hermann Wilhelm Ebel
relations.evidence: began to apply himself to comparative philology under August Pott.

relations.subject: Hermann Wilhelm Ebel
relations.evidence: Returning in the following year to his native city, he continued this study as a disciple of Franz Bopp.

relations.subject: Hermann Wilhelm Ebel
relations.evidence: In 1852 he accepted a professorship at the Beheim-Schwarzbach Institution at Filehne, a post he held for six years.

relations.subject: Hermann Wilhelm Ebel
relations.evidence: In 1858 he removed to Schneidemühl, and there he discharged the duties of first professor for ten years.

relations.subject: Hermann Wilhelm Ebel
relations.evidence: He was afterwards called to the chair of comparative philology at the University of Berlin.

relations.subject: Hermann Wilhelm Ebel
relations.evidence: Ebel contributed the Old Irish section to Schleicher's Indogermanische Chrestomathie (1869).
